trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central U-shaped depression with an approximate 75-degree angle of divergence at the vertex, depth approximately 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary, highlighted by high-intensity white pixel outlines against the dark dorsal field.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, following a parabolic trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast tan and white textured clusters located on the extreme lateral tips (left and right terminals), representing localized barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, low-latitude white linear streaks (scratches) visible on the black dorsal surface of the left lobe, oriented at approximately 45-degree angles relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips of both lobes; several linear rake-like marks on the dorsal surface.
